QPOP_input.readout: CellTiter-Glo luminescent viability; normalized scores enter second-order regression. No tumor-specific cell identification from ATP viability alone.

separate_validation_protocol.readout: CellTiter-Glo; single-drug fitted IC50 or fixed-ratio/matrix combination models; these method parameters are not inspected outcome values.

output: Predicted corresponding viabilities for permutations and drug-combination ranks; figure1g one-drug ranks are not released per-well raw viability, independent biological replicates or clinical effect.
controls: IC0 dose-level and normalized viability mentioned. Exact per-sample vehicle/untreated normalization, culture purity, dose table and time-condition crosswalk not supplied in the inspected fields. Technical duplicates/quadruplicates are not donors.
model_identity: Sec14 source labels T778 WDLPS, FU-DDLS-1/LPS141/LP6 DDLPS, MLS402 MLPS; existing model cautions preserved. ASC52telo is hTERT-immortalized adipose mesenchymal stem cell, not independent disease-normal donor safety control. No native EMC authentication transfers from these models.
supplement: Eight nonempty text page segments; page8 lists LPS141, FU-DDLS-1, MLS402, T778. Erratum supersedes original seven-page description, not original bytes. Protein-intensity/outcome values not inspected.
data_availability: Phenotypic drug sensitivity dataset upon reasonable request; RNA GSE282752 is a different measurement type; detailed Optim.AI software code proprietary/unavailable.
